title: Rifters — Fortune & Calamity
author: Sweaty_Shop3831
selftext:
**Playable Link:** [https://priced-out.satinypearl.chatgpt.site](https://priced-out.satinypearl.chatgpt.site)

**Platform:** Web browser — phones and computers

**Description:**

Rifters is a multiplayer board game for 2–8 players where you race to Tile 100 and claim the Golden Throne. Each turn, you roll a Fortune Die and a Calamity Die. The higher die determines your movement and whether luck favors you or the board.

The board has Fortune, Calamity, Gamble, Mystery, and Prison tiles. Depending on where you land, you might collect tools, face punishments, solve challenges, or spend time in prison. Wheel outcomes can change the race dramatically: swap positions with a rival, jump forward, lose all your Fortune Points, or get sent back 20 tiles.

Fortune Points let you improve wheel outcomes, while tools give you ways to protect yourself or disrupt other players. Sharing a tile triggers a duel, and temporary board events change the rules as the game progresses.

One player creates a room, and friends join using a room code. Everyone plays from their own device, with no accounts or downloads required. I’m looking for honest feedback on the rules, pacing, balance, and any bugs you encounter. You can also leave feedback through the Suggestions button in the game.
